## Summary of Changes

A concise explanation of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality or a new adapter)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that alters existing behavior or contracts)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance or security enhancement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`ruff check capforge/` passes).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`pytest tests/`).
- [ ] Any public API changes are updated in documentation.
